The four major component models of the PTES cycle (particle storage, PFB HX, compressor, and turbine/expander) have been validated against high-fidelity models on key metrics. A simple particle receiver model (based on receiver performance correlations from prior DOE-funded projects) was also built as part of a concurrent project.
